audit_endpoint_interpretation: maximum observed raw customer-delivery timestamp; not an authoritative administrative censoring date
purchase_interval_candidate_domain: daily snapshots on the independently frozen broad completion/availability EDA grid, from the 90-day warm-up snapshot through the last dense customer-delivery date; the eligibility audit is logically distinct and its endpoint may empirically coincide with the broad-grid endpoint
rank_snapshot_cadence: month_start within the complete daily interval; daily support and coverage retained
rank_comparison_pairs: A-B; A-each C; B-each C; adjacent C lags
historical_process_support: nonnegative descriptively valid durations only; negative raw values retained in audit and raw summaries
coverage_missing_mapping: missing mapping is reported separately and is not a cold start; cold start is mapped entity with zero historical support
hrd_calendar: complete calendar spine from first to last purchase date, zero-order days included in percentile denominator
hrd_quantile_rule: pandas linear quantile; values greater than or equal to cutoff flagged, ties retained
gmv_definition: sum of item price; freight reported separately
all_placed_enrichment: audit-only deterministic order-item/customer/seller mapping parallel to canonical logic; never a substitute canonical assembler
snapshot_engine: hybrid after pre-run parity audit: NumPy/indexed engine for slicing, support and future coverage only after real-data parity against the pandas reference; pandas reference engine for persisted rank agreement because the candidate fast rank path did not meet the 1e-11 real-data parity gate
